svg.aria-label: Capabilities. Cloud & Platform Engineering: One shared platform standard across the businesses, so an improvement made once carries across all of them. Infrastructure Modernization: Environments defined as code, versioned and reviewed, so every change is visible and recoverable. DevOps & Automation: Releases promoted from staging to production with the same artifact, gated by health checks. Cybersecurity: Fail-closed defaults, least-privilege access and deliberate approval for sensitive actions. Operational Resilience: Monitoring of the services that matter, with backup and recovery that is tested, not assumed. Workflow Automation: Business processes automated where they serve a clear purpose, with retries and monitoring built in. Quality & Accessibility: Automated testing and accessibility checks before anything is released. AI Governance: AI introduced only where it serves a clear business purpose, under the same review as any other change.
